mechanics.claim: Rammus dashes to the target location with crowd-control immunity for the duration of the dash.
mechanics.quote: leaps to the target location with {{tip|Cc-immunity}}

mechanics.claim: The initial impact damage and slow occur on arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Upon arrival, he creates an impact that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: If cast during Powerball, Soaring Slam also deals Powerball's damage to enemies in the epicenter and knocks them up.
mechanics.quote: enemies within the epicenter of the impact are also {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and are dealt ''{{ais|Powerball|Rammus}}'' damage

mechanics.claim: Casting during Powerball does not end the Powerball channel until after the dash.
mechanics.quote: its channel will be maintained for the dash and end afterwards

mechanics.claim: Each of the 3 aftershocks reapplies and refreshes the initial slow, but the wiki does not state they deal damage.
mechanics.quote: each one applying and refreshing the duration of the initial {{tip|slow}}

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks the initial impact (including the Powerball damage component) but not the aftershocks.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield will block the impact (including with {{ai|Powerball|Rammus}}) but not each aftershock

mechanics.claim: If the dash is interrupted, the ability produces no impact and no aftershocks.
mechanics.quote: will not impact nor generate aftershocks if the dash is interrupted

mechanics.claim: The ability has no cast time.
